title: Esrbespoke type-on
description: Text that types itself on: when it comes into view its letters appear one after another (opacity 0 to 1, about 12ms apart), as the original's hero notes and footer lines do. Static HTML shows the whole text; the effect only arms after JavaScript runs.
notes: needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible); without it the text is simply shown
words never break mid-word: each word is kept together
name: esrbespoke-type-on

props.name: delay
props.description: milliseconds to wait before the first letter

props.name: trigger
props.description:
when to start: "view" when it scrolls into view; "page-end" for text inside a footer the
page lifts off (stuck underneath, so always "in view"): when the page is near its end.
"page-end" falls back to "view" when no ancestor is actually sticky (e.g. on phones).
